name: Major cyber incidents
summary: US FinCEN takes some systems offline after unauthorised access disclosed on 24 Nov; FBI and CISA investigating
state: FinCEN, the US Treasury's financial intelligence unit, said on 24 Nov that an incident gave unauthorised access to a limited subset of its systems and took some offline; the FBI and CISA are involved and no breach of its core databases has been found (The Record). It extended affected filing deadlines to 30 Dec (Help Net Security). Disruption to a federal financial service keeps Watch; no national-scale attack on critical infrastructure was found.
for_you: Follow NCSC guidance on phishing and account security; attackers often exploit publicised breaches.
rubric_hit: Attack disrupting a critical government financial service

sources.title: The Record — Treasury's FinCEN takes systems offline after cybersecurity incident
Help Net Security — US agency tracking money laundering is latest casualty in string of federal breaches

why: Ransomware and state hacking now shut down hospitals, retailers, carmakers and airports for weeks.
drivers: Ransomware gangs, state actors, zero-days, supply-chain compromises.

rubric.alert: National-scale attack on critical infrastructure (power, health, finance), or a destructive state-attributed attack.
rubric.watch: Ransomware or attack disrupting a large company or critical service, or a mass-exploited zero-day.
rubric.normal: No major incidents disrupting critical services this week.
